description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and references/intent-guide.md to understand the multi-source retrieval system. (2) Recognize this is a multi-intent query: 'comparison' for Solana vs Ethereum, plus 'status/finance' for ETH realtime price. (3) Run scripts/search.py with --queries for the comparison part (e.g., 'Solana vs Ethereum' 'Solana advantages DeFi' 'Ethereum advantages DeFi') with --mode deep --intent comparison. (4) Run a separate scripts/search.py invocation for ETH price using --intent status --mode deep (or fast) and --source alpha-vantage,binance,gemini,kimi,tavily to activate the finance-aware realtime prioritization path. (5) Synthesize results into research_report.json organized by theme (not by provider), with conflict callouts, and finance data timestamped/attributed per SKILL.md synthesis rules.
